description: Raycast on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. Raycast is a productivity launcher (replaces Spotlight) distributed as a universal-binary DMG (no Rosetta required) and installed as a drag-and-drop .app at /Applications/Raycast.app. The default invoke hotkey is configurable; the use.computer sandbox blocks Cmd+Space (see 12_macos_environments.md) so tasks here interact with Raycast through its menu-bar item, configured hotkey, `open -a Raycast`, or the menu-bar UI. Verifiers use pgrep / lsappinfo / defaults reads of `com.raycast.macos` / file checks under ~/Library/Application Support/com.raycast.macos/ — no AppleScript-over-SSH (TCC blocks `tell System Events`).
